silent_swallows.description: Fetch to /api/roast fails silently — user sees empty battle phase with no data and no error feedback. Network errors, JSON parse failures, and server 500s all produce the same silent fallback.
silent_swallows.impact: User cannot distinguish between 'battle data loading' and 'battle endpoint broken'. Degrades to a blank RoastBattle component.

silent_swallows.description: Fetch to /api/compare fails silently — same pattern as above. User auto-advances to empty CompareCard.
silent_swallows.impact: User sees an empty comparison phase with no data. Identical failure mode to the roast fetch.

silent_swallows.description: Outer try/catch in handleAnalyze catches all errors (network, parse, runtime) and silently resets to landing page. No console.error, no user-visible message.
silent_swallows.impact: Any failure in the analyze flow silently resets the UX. User has no indication anything went wrong — appears as if the app just ignored their input.

silent_swallows.pattern: try { comparison = loadComparison(); } catch { /* Comparison unavailable */ }
silent_swallows.description: Silently swallows loadComparison() errors. Comment explains intent but no logging exists to diagnose why comparison data is unavailable.
silent_swallows.impact: Comparison data silently missing from analyze response. No observability into cache corruption or file-not-found issues.

silent_swallows.pattern: try { ... } catch { /* skip malformed chain data */ }
silent_swallows.description: Silently skips malformed leaderboard entries during parse. Acceptable for resilience but no logging means data quality issues are invisible.
silent_swallows.impact: Partial leaderboard data silently lost. Acceptable for demo but would mask data ingestion bugs in production.
